generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc. as per KTPP act and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency.

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least ONE financial years an minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.24.03 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted.
The Tenderer should have Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for at least any construction work to an extend of (25 % of the cost of the work with GST) of Rs.6.01 lakhs

Assessed available tender capacity should be AN5-B should be greater than 24.03 lakhs.A is Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress N is Number of years B is Value of on-going works

The Tenderer should upload the Caste Certificate in the Prescribed Format issued by GOK which is Mandatory. The Tenderer Belonging to Schedule Caste or Schedule Tribe shall be Domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years.If the Contractor is a Firm,then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to SC or ST as the case may be
The form of tender as per the proforma available in bid document should be duly filled and uploaded in the e-procurement portal as a part of tender document which is mandatory.
Amount put to tender is excluding GST. Rates quoted shall be excluding GST.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER BID DOCUMENT
DI PIPES will be supplied by Department as per schedule A
Bid Capacity has to be uploaded.
